cards.front: What must every ECG order identify?
cards.back: Patient, procedure, protocol, ordering provider, and any limitations/prep instructions.

cards.front: Order conflicts with what the patient says — what do you do?
cards.back: Perform only what is ordered and clarify with the ordering provider.

cards.front: Patient can't walk but has a treadmill order
cards.back: Contact the provider; they may change it to a pharmacologic stress test.

cards.front: How many patient identifiers are required?
cards.back: At least two (e.g., name and date of birth) — Joint Commission NPSG.01.01.01.

cards.front: Is a room number an identifier?
cards.back: No — never use room or bed number.

cards.front: Best way to ask an alert patient's identity
cards.back: Open-ended: "Please tell me your full name and date of birth."
